scope: operation-log ingest topology, backpressure, retry, acknowledgement, and shutdown drain

localQueue.knownRisk: postgres shutdown starts an async flush but does not explicitly await its completion

nonEquivalence: Go has no operation-log IPC forwarding path.
Go Asynq does not implement the Node local 5000-item or 32-MiB producer backpressure limits.
Go Asynq does not use the Node Redis Stream key, consumer group, XPENDING claim, or explicit ack-after-PostgreSQL-write protocol.
Go shutdown delegates in-flight handling to Asynq ShutdownTimeout; it does not run the Node bounded 100-batch drain.
Future Go ownership must guarantee durable enqueue or awaited PostgreSQL drain instead of copying Node's fire-and-forget PostgreSQL shutdown flush.
This golden is evidence for future cutover design, not evidence that Go owns operation-log ingest.
